title: Co2NiO4/NF as bidirectional catalyst for quinoxaline hydrogenation/tetrahydroquinoxaline dehydrogenation in flow batteries
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2026, Accepted Manuscript
DOI: 10.1039/D6SE00166A, Paper
Fangcheng Qiu, Nan Wang, Bowen Chen, Xin Zheng, Hanyu Li, Xue Han, Shaowen Tan, Siyi Chen, Shengping Wang
This study addresses key challenges in conventional catalysis for the quinoxaline/tetrahydroquinoxaline liquid organic hydrogen carrier (LOHC) pair. These challenges include high energy consumption, reliance on precious metals, and catalyst irreversibility....
